name: Azure DevOps
changes: Its release step says at the first look when no release exists for the merged build and none comes (no continuous-deployment trigger of the release definitions taking the build takes its branch), failing no-release in those words so the step holds for the person, rather than after findSeconds; with the createRelease option it makes that release from the build and watches it.
description: Daoris's work on Azure DevOps through its REST API, with the personal access token its own login keeps: pull-request opens a pull request from the branch Daoris pushed, sets auto-complete where asked, and reads its state and merge commit; release follows the merged commit's build and release to their end.

commands.name: login
commands.about: Keeps a personal access token for Azure DevOps' REST API in this plugin's own storage. Without one, the plugin uses the person's signed-in session in Daoris's browser.

commands.name: status
commands.about: Says whether a token is kept, since when, and whether Azure DevOps last refused it.

about.en: Opens an Azure DevOps pull request from a pushed branch into its target (the repository's default branch where none is named), or finds the active one; its data is the pull request's id, address and state.
about.zh: 从已推送的分支向目标分支（未指定则为仓库默认分支）创建 Azure DevOps 拉取请求，已有进行中的则直接找到；数据为拉取请求的编号、地址和状态。

title.en: Delete the source branch on completion
Transition linked work items on completion
title.zh: 完成时转换关联工作项

about.en: Says whether a pull request, named by its address or id or found from its branch, is open, completed or abandoned, with its address and merge commit as data.
about.zh: 说明一个拉取请求（按地址或编号指定，或从其分支找到）是进行中、已完成还是已放弃，数据含地址和合并提交。

title.zh: 拉取请求的地址或编号

about.en: Completes an active pull request by the merge strategy asked (merge where none is), its policies still deciding; one already completed is said so.
about.zh: 按所要求的合并策略（未指定则为合并）完成进行中的拉取请求，仍由其策略决定；已完成的会如实说明。

title.zh: 拉取请求的地址或编号

storage.for: The personal access token login keeps, and when Azure DevOps last refused it.

about.en: Opens an Azure DevOps pull request from the branch Daoris pushed to origin, or finds the active one, and sets auto-complete where its options ask. It sends nothing but its API calls, with the personal access token its own login keeps.
about.zh: 从 Daoris 已推送到 origin 的分支创建 Azure DevOps 拉取请求，已有进行中的则直接沿用，并按选项设置自动完成。只发送它的 API 请求，使用它自己登录时保存的个人访问令牌。

goal.en: Open an Azure DevOps pull request from the pushed branch into the line with create-pull-request (finding the active one where there is one), passing the step's options autoComplete, mergeStrategy, deleteSourceBranch, transitionWorkItems and mergeCommitMessage as its auto-complete arguments where they are given, check it with pull-request-status, and answer reached with its address as the evidence's url, its id as the pull-request output, and the tool's own words (its auto-complete sentence and its Way line) as the message; answer failed with the code a tool's refusal names where it cannot be opened.
goal.zh: 用 create-pull-request 从已推送的分支向主线创建 Azure DevOps 拉取请求（已有进行中的则找到它），步骤选项 autoComplete、mergeStrategy、deleteSourceBranch、transitionWorkItems、mergeCommitMessage 若给出则作为其自动完成参数传入，用 pull-request-status 确认，然后回答 reached，证据的 url 为其地址，pull-request 输出为其编号，message 取工具自己的话（自动完成一句和 Way 一行）；无法创建时回答 failed，代码取工具拒绝时给出的代码。

about.en: After the merge, watches the merged commit's build, then the classic release made from it or the pipeline run's own stages, to their end, saying at once when none comes. It can start a stage, and make the release where createRelease asks.
about.zh: 合并之后，跟踪合并提交的构建，再跟踪由它创建的经典发布或流水线运行自身的阶段，直到结束；该构建没有发布且不会有发布时立即说明。它可以启动尚未启动的阶段，并在 createRelease 选项要求时创建触发器不会创建的发布；审批和检查仍由 Azure DevOps 决定。

tools.for: Runs the plugin's plugin.mjs, its calls to Azure DevOps' REST API (fetch), and its connection to Daoris's browser (WebSocket).
